messages:
jessica-cs: FYI — GreenFields (acct GF-234) reporting account suspended after dunning. They say PO #PO-9987 was submitted and a bank transfer made yesterday but payment landed on a different customer account. Need quick reinstatement; legal/compliance on line. invoice INV-2026-045 is in dispute. :warning:

mike-billing: put in an accounting trace. can you drop the payment remittance or txn id? last4 of card on file is 4242? we can check auto-match rules.

jessica-cs: customer sent attachment to support case 98765 with bank ref `REF-20260315-GF`. Amount EUR 7,200. PO attached. They say our dunning email hit yesterday and suspension happened within minutes.

eli-cs: sorry about that. I've opened internal ticket ACC-7891 and tagged @linda-collections. Can we grant a 48h temporary reinstatement while we reconcile?

linda-collections: thanks @eli-cs. I can approve a 48h trial restore but need confirmation from billing that payment wasn't accepted to the right ledger. please confirm by EOD.

mike-billing: quick status — payment trace shows `BANK-TRACE-333` posted to our system yesterday but tagged to account GF-987 (old legacy). Looks like auto-match rule matched on customer name variant. We'll reassign once we have remittance. opened GL correction CR-1122.

raju-support: I've asked the customer to repost remittance to billing@redwood.com and cc support. they did that 10m ago. attached a screenshot in case it helps.

accounting-bot: Payment pm_bank_333 status: posted -> pending reallocation. Amount: EUR 7,200. Reference: REF-20260315-GF.

mike-billing: I manually applied payment to INV-2026-045 and raised CreditNote CN-204 to adjust GF-987. Will close ACC-7891 once reconcil's complete. Service hold flag removed. @jessica-cs pls confirm restore.

jessica-cs: confirmed with customer, service is back. They still need official receipt and VAT invoice with PO on it for their AP team. can billing send updated invoice PDF to billing@greenfields.example and cc accounts@redwood.com? :thumbsup: 

linda-collections: noted — will mark as resolved in collections tracker. adding 1-week manual monitor to avoid repeats.

tony-sales: heads up — GreenFields is considering Dedicated plan; please include my team on the postmortem so we can avoid auto-match pitfalls during migrations.

mike-billing: action items: 1) send updated VAT invoice (INVOICE_SENT-1801) 2) update auto-match rules to include account alias GF-234 3) follow up with finance ops to close CR-1122. I'll update ACC-7891.

jessica-cs: thanks everyone. Marking thread resolved from CS side.
